_comment: Tier-1 mcp_tool source preset(s) for objectstore-mcp (AU-KG.ingest.mcp-tool-connector). The action-routed 'objects' tool lists objects under a bucket/prefix; each record is an object metadata envelope (key/size/etag/content_type/last_modified). Contributed presets win over the central MCP_TOOL_PRESETS. For richer typed :Bucket/:Object ingestion prefer the native 'objectstore_ingest' tool + objectstore_mcp.kg_ingest.
